subject: FINAL HANDOFF — Agent06 Physical Glass Renderer
body: Research Agent 06 complete at current main 413d4a722fe8193f15ff086595f10d1464505ace. Final renderer recommendation: one deterministic frozen transition frame + one corrected AGSL optical surface + one presentation host (compatible with Agent05 SurfaceControl proposal) + Samsung steady-state handoff. Confirmed current-source defects: DuoShader targets 89.5deg while AGSL clamps 60deg, causing cover geometry plateau ~13.57->20deg hinge and inner ~20->70.10deg; RuntimeShader-input BitmapShader defaults to NEAREST because filter mode is not explicitly set. First debug A/B: MAX_TILT=60 and FILTER_MODE_LINEAR only. Local deterministic mapping tests PASS (8 assertions + strict monotonic checks). Current half-resolution AGSL blurred path has a fixed 32-iteration source loop and requires Fold7 120Hz GPU measurement before tap reduction; test 16/12 taps + bounded radius only after correctness. Full-res FlatView to half-res FoldView hard threshold is a source-level onset-pop risk requiring physical observation before crossfade. Do not revive LiveBlurSurface, do not add blur pyramid or HardwareBuffer transport before measurements. Test Bitmap.prepareToDraw before zero-copy rewrite. Primary live status now explicitly accepts the 60-degree visual domain + linear filtering finding. Production code was not committed by Agent06; proposal patch is R&D-only.
